text:
Tara Singh: quick heads-up  SI Hub onramp planning. objective: pilot a 3-week combined onboarding + cert window for 5 SI teams, plus a standing mentor swap roster and an HW SLA annex for partner racks. want to avoid mentor burnout & clarify SLAs. thoughts? :clipboard:
Evan Morales: agree. recommend a primary + backup mentor per cohort. backups cover PTO/sprint weeks. propose 10am PT and 20:00 CET recurring mentor handoff doc.
Sofia Petrov: SLA annex needs explicit recovery steps and an escalation matrix for vendor-side infra (rack unavailable, network flakiness, staging API rate limits). i'll draft annex and a short incident template.
Luis Ortega: on mentor swap  suggest a shared rota spreadsheet with auto-notify when a mentor marks OOO. we can use the ops-bot to ping the backup. also propose short overlap windows (30m) for handoffs.
Tara Singh: good. @Sofia can you include max acceptable outage per lab slot (e.g., 15m tolerance) and credit remediation (partner credits or makeup session)?
Sofia Petrov: yes. proposing: if outage >15m and <60m, offer a one-hour make-up; if >60m, full session replay + partner credit. will add sample language for marketplace listings too.
Evan Morales: for roster: collect mentor skill tags (serving-runtime, quant, ops, infra-debug) and preferred handoff cadence (daily/weekly/biweekly). i'll circulate CSV and a short intake form.
Luis Ortega: vendor note: vendor said they will not support recordings by default due to data policy, but will allow per-session opt-in with an AUP signed. ops-bot can track consent states.
support-bot: reminder created: "SI Hub onramp: collect mentor roster" due in 48h. link: https://tasks.redwood.ai/task/si-onramp-roster
Tara Singh: logistics recap: Sofia = SLA annex + incident template, Evan = roster CSV + intake form, Luis = ops-bot rota + vendor consent flow. target: ship the pilot schedule + annex by Mon (3667960000). I'll host a 20m readout Thu 9am PT.
Evan Morales: adding a tiny mentor FAQ: common fixes (OOM -> switch to fallback model, auth error -> regen key, kv-cache miss -> warm prefix). will drop in playbook.
Sofia Petrov: also adding a graded rubric for capstone troubleshooting (timeliness, diagnosis, mitigation) and a pass threshold. draft by EOD tomorrow.
Luis Ortega: once roster is in, i'll map mentors to cohort windows and publish the swap-oncall calendar.
